title: Sample Report
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: respond to a written stimulus and use appropriate register, style and format for the given purpose and audience
produce written texts with a range of grammatical and lexical structures
communicate factual information, ideas and arguments clearly and with expansion
select and organise relevant information and ideas into coherent text using appropriate linking devices

Candidates write 120–160 words of continuous prose for report, in response to the rubric. The rubric includes information on the format of the response, its purpose and audience. A more formal response is required. Candidates are awarded up to 6 marks for content (task fulfilment and the development of ideas) and up to 9 marks for language (range, accuracy and organisation)
